text.p: President Clinton and first lady Hillary Rodham Clinton Saturday celebrated their daughter Chelsea's high school graduation, joining other parents and students at private brunch.

Clinton, who recorded his weekly radio address so it wouldn't interfere with the celebrations, went with his wife and daughter to a brunch at a home in Darnestown, Md., a 45-minute drive from the White House.
On Saturday evening, the Clintons joined Chelsea, her friends and other parents at an outdoor cookout in Brookeville, Md.

Chelsea Clinton and 121 of her classmates graduated Friday from Sidwell Friends School, with Clinton delivering a sentimental commencement speech that mixed parental pride with a call for the graduates to "chase your dreams."
Friday night, the Clintons attended a reception for parents and graduates at a four-story home in the exclusive Foxhall neighbourhood in Washington.
Chelsea, escorted by four young men, left the reception to attend other parties about a half-hour before her parents departed.
